title: 《The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time》重制版首周销量突破 500 万份
content:
Ocarina of Time exceeds 5 million copies solid in first week
Business
Console
News
The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time exceeds 5 million copies sold in first week
The remake of the 1998 game becomes the second-highest selling Switch 2 title in only four days.
Imran Khan
,
Contributing Editor
,
GameDeveloper.com
November 11, 2026
schedule
1 Min Read
via Nintendo
Newsbrief:
Nintendo has announced that
The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time
on Switch 2 has sold 5.2 million copies since the game was released on November 5. This number includes both physical and digital copies and is catching up in a matter of days what took the original game—itself no slouch when it comes to fast sales—two years with 7.6 million copies,
according to archived Nintendo data
.
It also places
Ocarina of Time
as the second best-selling title on the Switch 2, trailing behind Mario Kart World.
For more information on
Ocarina of Time
's Switch 2 sales results, be sure to
read Nintendo's full announcement here
.
